test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

After the trek, I felt a ______ pain in my leg.
solution: The correct answer is '**severe**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**severe**'. • The word '**severe**' means **'causing somebody to suffer, be upset or have difficulties'.** (कठोर, सख्‍़त (जिससे व्‍यक्ति को तकलीफ़, परेशानी या कठिनाई हो)) • *Example: Such terrible crimes deserve the **severest** punishment.* **Correct Sentence:__** *After the trek, I felt a **severe** pain in my leg.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Strict**: not allowing people to break rules or behave badly. (सख्‍़त, कठोर (नियम भंग या ग़लत व्‍यवहार को सहन न करने वाला)) • **Stern**: very serious; not smiling. (कठोर, बहुत गंभीर; मुस्‍कान-रहित) • **Sour**: having a sharp taste like that of a lemon. (नींबू के जैसे तीखे स्‍वाद वाला; खट्टा, अम्‍ल) 3a:Taf9, The correct answer is '**powerful**'.
